summary: First-pass end-to-end testing of CleanOps SaaS platform. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests passing (auth, signup, tenant isolation, plan feature gating, Stripe checkout, platform admin suspend/extend-trial, staff mgmt, public booking preview, access restriction). Frontend: 11/11 Playwright checks passing (root->/login redirect, platform admin login & tabs, self-serve signup landing on /admin with trial banner, zero demo data for new tenant, Billing page with 3 plans + monthly/annual toggle, nav hides locked features for Growth trial, Solid Clean owner login, public /c/solid-clean/quote renders with AI receptionist widget and live-price quote). Live Stripe checkout URL successfully generated in test mode.

issues: Recharts console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - likely a chart container that mounts before layout settles. Non-blocking but worth adding minWidth/minHeight or ResponsiveContainer aspect prop.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer sizing warnings on /admin overview to silence console noise.

Not retested end-to-end: actual Stripe test-card checkout completion -> /admin/billing?session_id=... sync to 'active' and prorated plan switch (requires interactive card entry on hosted Stripe page). Billing sync endpoint is covered by backend code but a full happy-path with 4242... should be verified manually or via a Stripe-API mock run.
Not retested end-to-end: public /c/{slug}/quote -> Stripe payment -> /payment/success -> booking marked confirmed/paid (same reason as above).
Not covered: AI receptionist chat message generation (LLM calls skipped to keep run fast); SEO audit AI call for Pro-comped tenant was only verified for 403 absence, not content quality.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.py:252 - stripe webhook json.loads(str(event['data']['object'])) relies on Stripe event objects being str-convertible to JSON; works but brittle. Prefer event['data']['object'].to_dict_recursive() or dict(obj).

routes_saas.py:287 - _session() silently falls back from automatic_tax to managed_payments to vanilla; good resilience, but failures are logged only once with keys of extras, not the Stripe error reason.

core.py:171 - current_user looks up user with password_hash excluded; refresh endpoint uses find_one without excluding password_hash (routes_auth.py:57) - minor leak if payload ever logged; harmless as not returned.
routes_saas.py:200 - add_staff counts active users to enforce max_staff; passes gating via require_owner, but a race condition could allow >limit if two concurrent POSTs - acceptable for MVP.
server.py: no /api/health endpoint; root is /api/ which works. Fine.
Frontend: Admin Overview triggers chart render with container width=-1 (Recharts warning). Wrap chart in a container with explicit min-height or use ResponsiveContainer with aspect prop.

seed_data_creation: Each run creates ~1-2 TEST_Co_<uuid> companies via /api/auth/signup and 1 TEST_staff user, left behind in Mongo (prefixed with TEST_ as required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_saas.py and are safe to re-run - they create new TEST_ companies each run. All critical SaaS flows (auth, tenant isolation, plan gating, suspend/reactivate, staff lifecycle, billing checkout, platform admin) are green. Only gaps are interactive Stripe hosted-page completions (card 4242...) which cannot be automated headlessly without stepping through Stripe UI. If retesting UI, note that signup auto-navigates to /admin/settings (not /admin dashboard) on first signup - this is because overview page uses Recharts which triggers a warning but still renders.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues found. Only one test selector was initially wrong (used /admin/outreach/prospects instead of /admin/prospects); fixed in test file.
